lines: In six half śāstras all indeed by whom was mastered; rite maṇḍala etc he Rāmagupta; Guru Śaṃbhu śāstra service rite devoted complete path.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ṣaḍardhaśāstreṣu samastameva yenādhijagme vidhimaṇḍalādi sa rāmagupto guruśaṃbhuśāstrasevāvidhivyagrasamagramārgaḥ
